connector.name: Attestd MCP
connector.registryDescription: CVE and supply chain checks for MCP clients. Covers infrastructure, PyPI, and npm packages.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the attestd-io account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: ATTESTD_API_KEY
env.description: Attestd API key (atst_...). Required for check_package_vulnerability and check_batch_vulnerabilities. Get one at https://api.attestd.io/portal

env.name: ATTESTD_BASE_URL
env.description: Optional API base URL override. Defaults to https://api.attestd.io
